review.notes: Full token-level diff of all 36 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown plus a fence/heading structure scan; page 30 was rendered whole and pages 1 and 22 were inspected via 300 dpi crops. The five ```txt fences in Appendix A are balanced and transcribe printed prompt-box content, so no swallowed-structure risk. The five appendix A headings match the print; the Appendix B heading 'B. Additional results' (physical p.30) was dropped by the OCR while its Figures 11-12 were kept, and is restored. Apparent droppages in the diff resolved as figure-internal diagram and response-panel text already shown by the embedded figure images (architecture Fig. 2, dispatcher Fig. 5, RL training figures, benchmark samples, and the Appendix B response panels). Table reading-order pairs ('MCQ' before 'Total') come from rowspan header layout, not content loss.
